description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for logging components within an Android application's logging framework. It includes a method for printing log data with various parameters such as priority, tag, message, and optional throwable.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: Interface for logging nodes that can output log information and be chained together.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to instruct the first LogNode in the chain to print log data with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable.
